title: 第1548章 诸我归一完第1547章 诸我归一五
lines: 轰轰轰！
金色大河以那尊青黑故始大鼎作支撑，流遍了此间天地！
它将三清洗刷成一副黑白二色道炁缠绕的骸骨，三清自身诸部血肉脏腑，则皆在金沙河流气韵洗刷之下，崩解气化，向着大鼎上空不断蒸腾——它的血肉脏腑、诸般之‘我’，在大鼎上空云蒸霞蔚之中，化作了一块块瓦片、一根根木柱、一颗颗石头！
如此诸般重组着，叠合着，聚成了一座高古大庙！
不见门额，庙墙遍布烈火灼烧痕迹的大庙之前，一道斑驳牌坊隐约浮现，牌坊上的‘仙门’二字已经金漆斑驳。
而那道牌坊下，隐约有道高胖身影捧着一团烛火，将它供奉到了那座由三清诸我垒砌而成的大庙之中——
随着那团火苗落入庙内，整座大庙里明光堂堂，三清驻留于此的诸我气韵，皆被光明炼烧成虚无——整座大庙彻底被定住，不可能再被三清收摄回去——只剩下一副骸骨的三清，肩扛着那座高古大庙，口中低低出声：“完人，完人……
完人已死？
或是，已证……诸我归一……”
带着这样低沉的呢喃声，只剩下一副骸骨的三清，扛着那座压在它肩头的高古大庙，沿着金沙河流漫过天地虚空，击穿苍穹留下的‘河床’，朝此般天地之外走去。
洪荒之中。
遍处金沙气韵星星点点。
无数金沙气韵交织在这枯寂的、已死的黑暗洪荒之中，形成了一道直通向元河起源的河道。
河道尽头，还能看到大天仿似有无数厉诡堆积坟土而成的陵墓本形。
三清看了河道尽头的‘皇天真形’一眼，便扛着那座重塑了人道起源，使人与诡得以齐平的高古大庙，沿着河床，朝河道尽头而去。
那承载着完人气韵、疑似已证诸我归一的金沙河流，朝着三清直灌而下的时候，它的道途已然彻底被斩。
它无望证就诸我归一，当下之所以如此，只不过是想到元河起源去亲眼看看，是不是如自己猜测的那般？
完人已证诸我归一？
哪怕元河起源处有大天‘皇天真形’镇守，它以当下这副羸弱的姿态去往彼处，必会为大天所杀——也在所不惜！
弥漫金沙气韵的河道之外，无边寂暗之中，元河静静流淌，有此金沙河流衬托，更显元河广大无边。
但河中空明大水，却不能侵染那金沙气韵一丝一毫，有此元河衬托，更显金沙气韵永恒真如。
三清迈过河道，徐徐向前。
在它身后，那金沙河道接连的鸡卵天地之中，燧皇、柳飞烟、丹加、张角等黄天道众从中爬出，他们在与天师道的交战之中早已伤痕累累，如今互相搀扶着，也沿着那条河道，走向元河起源之地。
燧皇、丹加等人离去鸡卵天地不知多久，直至金沙河道之中，已然难见他们身影的时候，又有一些人从鸡卵天地中爬出，沿着这条从未走过的、存在于他们祖祖辈辈传说中的道路，走向那河道尽头。
一些人走入河道……
无数人踏上河道……
他们在鸡卵天地之中，闯下了偌大声名。
他们听闻自己的前辈曾经走过这‘人道大河’，于是一代接一代地、循着先人的踪迹，走入河道之中。
元河尽头，漆黑棺椁的震颤愈发狂烈。
守在棺椁之外的‘皇天真形’避过那气势广大、令它不能直面、隐隐有证就‘诸我归一’之气象的金沙河流，它看着那金沙河流贯通元河，往鸡卵天地而去，在原地沉默了良久，继而将性识落在漆黑棺椁之上。
是谁获得了证就诸我归一的机会？
是我？
还是完人？
它不能再继续这般等待猜测下去，便将那道推灭了大半宇宙洪荒的紫红手臂伸出来，卷起那道不断涌出五色斑斓之光的漆黑棺椁，将一道手指小心翼翼地伸入棺椁之内。
棺椁中。
content_en:
Boom boom boom!
The golden river is supported by the green and black ancient cauldron, flowing throughout the world!
It brushed the Three Purities into a skeleton entwined with black and white Dao Qi. All the flesh and blood and organs of the Three Purities were washed by the aura of the Jinsha River, disintegrated and vaporized, and continued to steam toward the sky above the cauldron - its flesh and blood, organs and all kinds of "I", in the steaming clouds above the cauldron, turned into pieces of tiles, wooden pillars, and stones!
All these were reorganized and superimposed to form an ancient temple!
In front of the large temple, with no door visible and traces of fire burning all over the temple walls, a mottled archway loomed, and the words "Xianmen" on the archway were mottled with gold paint.
Under the archway, there was a vaguely tall and fat figure holding a candle and enshrining it in the large temple built by the Three Pure Ones——
Buzz…
As the flames fell into the temple, the entire temple was filled with bright light, and all the auras of the Three Purities residing here were refined and burned into nothingness by the light. The entire temple was completely immobilized and could no longer be taken back by the Three Purities. Only a skeleton of the Three Purities was left. Carrying the ancient temple on its shoulders, the Sanqing murmured in a low voice: "Perfect person, perfect person..."
The perfect man is dead?
Or, it has been proved...that all selves are unified..."
With such a low murmur, only a skeleton of Sanqing was left, carrying the ancient temple on its shoulders, flowing through the void of heaven and earth along the Jinsha River, breaking through the 'river bed' left by the sky, and walking towards the outside of this world.
In the wilderness.
There are dots of golden sand everywhere.
Countless golden sands are intertwined in this dry, dead and dark wasteland, forming a river that leads directly to the origin of the Yuan River.
At the end of the river, you can still see the sky, which looks like a mausoleum made of countless piles of graves.
Sanqing glanced at the 'Emperor's True Form' at the end of the river, and then carried the ancient temple that had reshaped the origin of humanity and brought humans and monsters on an equal footing, along the river bed towards the end of the river.
When the golden sand river, carrying the perfect human spirit and seemingly proving the unity of all self, flows straight down towards Sanqing, its path has been completely cut off.
It has no hope of proving that all selves are unified. The reason why it is like this now is just to think about the origin of the Yuan River and see with my own eyes. Is it as I guessed?
The perfect person has realized that all of us are unified?
Even if the origin of the Yuan River is guarded by the Great Heaven's 'Emperor's True Form', if it goes there in this weak posture, it will definitely be killed by the Great Heaven - no matter what!
Outside the river filled with the charm of golden sand, in the boundless darkness, the Yuan River flows quietly. With this golden sand river as a foil, the Yuan River is even more vast and boundless.
However, the bright and clear water in the river cannot infect the golden sand charm at all. With this Yuan River as a foil, the golden sand charm is eternal and true.
Sanchimai crossed the river and moved forward slowly.
Behind it, in the chicken egg world connected by the golden sand river, Suihuang, Liu Feiyan, Danjia, Zhang Jiao and other Huangtian Taoists crawled out. They had been scarred in the battle with Tianshi Dao, and now they supported each other and walked along the river to the origin of Yuan River.
Suihuang, Danjia and others left the Chicken Egg World for an unknown period of time. When they were no longer visible in the Jinsha River, some people crawled out of the Chicken Egg World and walked towards the end of the river along this road that had never been traveled before and existed in the legends of their ancestors.
Some people walked into the river...
Countless people set foot on the river...
They have made such a big name in the chicken egg world.
They heard that their predecessors had walked through this "river of humanity", so generation after generation, they followed the traces of their ancestors and walked into the river.
…
At the end of Yuan River, the trembling of the dark coffin became more and more violent.
The 'Emperor's True Form' guarding outside the coffin avoided the golden sand river, which was so majestic that it could not face it directly, and which vaguely demonstrated the atmosphere of 'everything is unified'. It watched the golden sand river running through the Yuan River and heading towards the chicken egg world. It remained silent for a long time, and then dropped its sexual consciousness on the dark coffin.
Who has been given the opportunity to realize the unity of all self?
Is it me?
Or perfect?
It could no longer continue to wait and guess, so it stretched out the purple-red arm that had destroyed most of the universe, rolled up the pitch-black coffin that was constantly pouring out colorful lights, and carefully inserted a finger into the coffin.
In the coffin.
title_en: Chapter 1548: All of us have returned to one. Chapter 1547: All of us have returned to one and five.
